about.heading: About VaaniEHR
about.prototypeBody: This is not approved for use with real patients. Do not enter real patient data.
about.intendedUse: VaaniEHR is a research prototype that helps a registered medical practitioner record a general-medicine OPD consultation and consider guideline-based follow-up questions and essential-medicine options. It informs clinical management; it does not diagnose, treat, or replace clinical judgement. Every clinical output requires review and sign-off by the practitioner. It is used only with acted or simulated consultations and is not approved for use with real patients.
